name: Omgato
author: Kurt Buhler
description: Key Lights, Stream Deck, Cam Link and Prompter in one Omarchy panel.

barWidget.description: Key Light brightness and temperature, the Stream Deck key grid and pedal, Cam Link overlay placement with quick recording, and Prompter scripts.

schema.label: Key Lights
schema.description: Brightness, temperature and per-light control for Key Lights.

schema.label: Stream Deck
schema.description: Key grid, pages and pedal bindings for a Stream Deck.

schema.label: Cam Link
schema.description: Camera overlay placement and quick screen recording. Turn off to leave recording to another plugin.

schema.label: Prompter
schema.description: Scroll scripts on an Elgato Prompter, or use it as a monitor.
